about: Synthetic controller for /studio/?script=fixture. `initial` plays on load exactly as written. `on_command` maps a command key to the events the controller sends back: `answer:<question_id>:<option_id>`, `change_decision:<question_id>`, `answer_batch:<batch_id>:<question_id>=<option_id>,...` (answers sorted by question_id, so each combination has its own truthful answer). Events under on_command are TEMPLATES: the fixture transport stamps session_id, generation, seq (next in DELIVERY order) and op_id at delivery, and artifact_version (current+1 for artifact.patch, current otherwise) - the way a real controller would - so any order the visitor chooses stays consistent. An event marked x_keep_version keeps the versions written on it: those are the traps the page must refuse. No network, no model, no microphone. Every option a card shows has a scripted answer; a card never offers Change or Decide later without one. x_bump_revision on a question.superseded template means the transport stamps it one task revision above the current one, as a real correction does.
